source_bytes.basis: The accepted source plan is 823461438 bytes; 1 GiB is the frozen acquisition ceiling.

canonical_bytes.basis: The 2-cell representative compile used 10870545 bytes; linear 105x cell scaling is about 1.14 GB and the 2 GiB ceiling retains bounded feature-density headroom.

full_compile_seconds.basis: The accepted 2-cell compile took 4.965 seconds; linear 105x scaling is about 522 seconds and the 15-minute ceiling covers larger feature selection without accepting an unbounded build.

features.basis: The representative source produced 1194 selected features; the territory bbox is about 18x larger and 100000 retains more than 4x density headroom.

cells.basis: The frozen inclusive selection x=-6..8 and y=-6..7 contains exactly 210 cells.

generated_packages.basis: Allows map, 210 terrain cells, World Partition external packages, and bounded layer packages; Slice 3 measurements may tighten it.

unreal_import_seconds.basis: A 30-minute unattended realization ceiling protects iteration time before territory-scale measurements exist.

cook_seconds.basis: A one-hour clean shipping cook ceiling is conservative for the first 210-cell package and must be attributed against the no-territory baseline.

installed_bytes.basis: The current staged build is about 4.82 GB; 8 GiB caps the first territory build while leaving measurable content headroom.

generated_actor_count.basis: Terrain and unique generated objects remain actors; repeated foliage and similar populations must use instancing rather than one actor per feature.

p95_frame_time_ms.basis: Operator target is 60 FPS at High settings on desktop RTX 4070-class hardware.

peak_memory_bytes.basis: Caps packaged process memory at 12 GiB on the reference traversal before measured tuning.

peak_gpu_memory_bytes.basis: Caps dedicated GPU memory at 10 GiB, retaining headroom on the 12 GiB desktop RTX 4070 reference target.

streaming_cell_load_seconds.basis: Each requested World Partition cell must become usable within two seconds during deterministic traversal.

streaming_hitch_ms.basis: Streaming must not create a measured hitch longer than 50 ms on the reference route.

territory_traversal_seconds.basis: The automated route may accelerate travel but must exercise load, unload, reload, collision, and frame sampling across the 11.16 km product diameter within 15 minutes.
